scientific_integrity: The full result is proved by a uniform Hamming-neighborhood intersection argument and a complete rigidity case split. Exhaustive finite checks are supporting evidence, not proof of infinite claims. Known Hamming neighborhood lemmas and VC-dimension bounds are credited to the cited source. The work has not undergone independent external audit.
scientific_limitations: No count is asserted for maximal scales in the small 2- and 3-dimensional exceptional cases.
Counts concern maximal contranominal subcontexts, not arbitrary Boolean sublattices or all lower-dimensional subcontexts.
Equivalent priority under alternative graph or FCA terminology remains a possibility.
title: Extremal contranominal scales of open Hamming adjacency contexts
